newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS to step up flights to Delhi, Beijing.
newsitem.headline: SAS to step up flights to Delhi, Beijing.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System SAS said on Thursday it was increasing the frequencies of its flights to Beijing and Delhi from Copenhagen.

The number of flights to Beijing will increase to five times weekly from four beginning September 19, in line with the airline's plans to operate daily flights to both Hong Kong and Beijing, SAS said in a statement.
SAS started operating a fifth frequency on its Copenhagen-Hong Kong flight in April.
Flights to Delhi, which re-opened two years ago, will increase to four frequencies per week from three.
"We have seen excellent passenger figures on this route," said Mette Ostergaard-Sorensen, responsible for the Delhi route, in the statement. "In the last two months we've seen a 40 percent increase.
The airline said it had permission to add a fifth frequency to Delhi from 1998 but that it would not make a decision about that until later.
SAS is partly owned by the governments of Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
